helpers.editableTarget: const editableTarget = (kind: string): EventTarget => { if (kind === "input" || kind === "textarea") { return { tagName: kind } as unknown as EventTarget; } return { tagName: "div", isContentEditable: false, contentEditable: "inherit", getAttribute: (name: string): string | null => name === "contenteditable" ? "true" : null } as unknown as EventTarget; };
helpers.makeContext: const makeContext = (gesture: unknown): { context: Parameters<typeof handleKeyDown>[1]; setValues: unknown[]; modalReads: number } => { const setValues: unknown[] = []; let modalReads = 0; const context = { state: {}, ui: { modalGesture: (): unknown => { modalReads += 1; return gesture; }, setModalGesture: (next: unknown): void => { setValues.push(next); } }, geometry: undefined, rect: {}, save: (): void => {}, beginTextEdit: (): void => {} } as unknown as Parameters<typeof handleKeyDown>[1]; return { context, setValues, modalReads }; };
helpers.makeEvent: const makeEvent = (key: string, target: EventTarget | null): KeyboardEvent => ({ key, target, metaKey: false, ctrlKey: false, shiftKey: false } as KeyboardEvent);
helpers.nonEditingTarget: const nonEditingTarget = (): EventTarget => ({ tagName: "div", isContentEditable: false, contentEditable: "inherit", getAttribute: (): string | null => null } as unknown as EventTarget);

helpers.commandForChord: const commandForChord = (key: string, meta: boolean, shift: boolean): string | undefined => KEYMAP.find(({ chord }) => chord.key === key && Boolean(chord.meta) === meta && Boolean(chord.shift) === shift)?.command;
